title: C2 Hacks 2025
shortDescription: A hackathon chat app: a Next.js front end with accounts, chats, streaks, and tasks, backed by a C++ service.
longDescription:
Built for C2 Hacks 2025. The front end is a Next.js and TypeScript app with sign-up and login via NextAuth, per-chat pages, and components for messages, streaks, and tasks.

The back end is a separate C++ project built with CMake that models users, contacts, direct and group chats, and messages, with its own account API and database layer.
highlights: C++ / CMake back end with direct and group chats
